patches.name: Wayland IME Preedit Cursor
patches.description: Respect the IME preedit cursor and selection, converting Wayland UTF-8 byte offsets to GPUI UTF-16 positions. Requires rebuilding and restarting Zed.

patches.name: Native Background Settings
patches.description: Native background settings, image selection, editor composition and cached image blur. Rebuild and restart required after source application.
